releases.notes:
Reliability fixes to the update system itself. Nothing about how your home behaves changes.

When ASCIA could not apply an update to one of its own components, it previously reported the
wrong cause and would refuse that version permanently — even when the real reason was temporary,
such as storage being briefly full or another component still finishing an earlier update. It now
works out what actually happened, only takes recovery action when something is genuinely broken,
and tries again once the temporary condition clears.

It also now checks that a component update matches the set this version of ASCIA OS was built and
tested with, and declines anything that does not.
